_comment: Content and figures for /case/c-medical (built by scripts/build-case-cmedical.mjs). Figures: C-Medical's Google Ads account (692-047-3801) and GA4 property (419601371) via Windsor.ai, retrieved 5 November 2026, 1 February to 5 November 2026 against the same days of 2025, the tracking gap 13 July to 23 August left out of both years (236 counted days). Named with the clinic group's written permission (owner, 20 Oct 2026); revenue figures are estimates built on the owner's stated assumptions (attendance 92%, first consultation NOK 1,950, procedure NOK 59,000, 35 to 60% of consultations lead to a procedure). Never a commission rate. The build refuses em dashes, exclamation marks and a rate near the word commission.

meta.title: C-Medical: 45% more bookings on the same traffic | Elevate Marketing
meta.description: A Norwegian private clinic group, 1 February to 5 November 2026 against the same days of 2025: 3,734 online bookings against 2,567 on 3.5% more visits. Google Ads, SEO and AI search, every figure and what it does not prove.
meta.ogDescription: Nine months for a private clinic group. 45% more online bookings on 3.5% more visits. Google Ads rebuilt one door at a time, SEO and AI search. Every figure, and what it does not show.

chapters.h2: One account, rebuilt one door at a time.

items.title: The takeover
items.line: We took over the Google Ads account on 25 January 2026 and rebuilt it from eleven broad campaigns into one per treatment area.
items.alt: A hand-drawn floor plan on cream paper with a pencil and brass ruler

items.title: More bookings, each one cheaper
items.bigLabel: Google Ads bookings, at 13% lower cost each
items.line: 1,601 bookings against 1,251, with the cost of a booking down from £87 to £76. Taps on the phone number rose 41%.
items.alt: An empty clinic reception counter in oak and stone with a single eucalyptus stem

items.title: Found without paying
items.line: Technical and content SEO from February and a new website in August: 1,547 organic bookings against 932, on only 12% more organic visits.
items.alt: A neat stack of printed pages on a pale oak desk with a fountain pen

items.title: The answer in AI search
items.bigLabel: visits from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini and Claude
items.line: 1,313 visits against 623, and four times the bookings from them.
